description: This file defines a Log class used for logging messages at various levels (info, warning, error, documentation issue) with configurable visibility and output formatting. It provides methods to log messages, display headers, and dump accumulated logs.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A class for managing and displaying log messages with different severity levels and formatting options.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor to initialize logging settings, including verbosity and output color formatting based on the operating system.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print messages, optionally prefixed with a file label.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if verbosity is enabled.

methods.name: DocIssue
methods.description: Logs a documentation issue message if documentation issue reporting is enabled.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if warnings are enabled.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message associated with a specific object, including line and file information if available.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints a message directly to the console, with optional file prefix.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated logs (errors, warnings, info).

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Logs the start of processing for a specific file.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string for concise display, adding ellipsis if necessary.
